'''Impellam Group plc''' (traded on the [[Alternative Investment Market|AIM]] as "IPEL") is a provider of Managed Services and Specialist Staffing and operates across the UK, North America, Australasia, Europe, and the Middle East.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Impellam Group|url=https://www.impellam.com/|access-date=2021-01-25|website=ImpellamGroup|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Impellam Group PLC, IPEL:LSE profile – FT.com|url=https://markets.ft.com/data/equities/tearsheet/profile?s=IPEL:LSE|access-date=2021-01-25|website=markets.ft.com}}</ref>

Impellam Group plc provides jobs at all levels, including doctors, lawyers, accountants, nurses, teachers, scientists, receptionists, drivers, chefs, administrators, engineers, technology specialists, cleaners, security guards, and manufacturing and warehouse operatives.<ref>{{cite news | url=http://shares.telegraph.co.uk/fundamentals/?epic=ipel | title=Stocks Shares | newspaper=The Telegraph | date=31 August 2023 }}</ref>

Julia Robertson has been the [[CEO]] of the group since April 2013.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Investegate {{!}} Company News {{!}} Corporate, London Stock Exchange, Regulatory News Headlines Impellam appoints CEO|url=https://www.investegate.co.uk/News/impellam-appoints-ceo/415481/|access-date=2021-01-25|website=investegate.co.uk}}</ref>
